Package aor.proj3t.daos.impl

Class NotificationDAOimpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.AbstractDAO<Notification,Long>
aor.proj3t.daos.impl.NotificationDAOimpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
BasicDAO<Notification,Long>, NotificationDAO
public class NotificationDAOimpl extends AbstractDAO<Notification,Long> implements NotificationDAO
Stateless EJB implementation of the NotificationDAO interface.

This class provides concrete implementation for managing system notifications within the application. It extends AbstractDAO to leverage common CRUD operations and implements specific business logic for notification delivery, pagination, and bulk operations.

Key implementation features:

  • Optimized queries with automatic ordering by timestamp
  • Pagination support for large notification lists
  • Efficient counting operations for pagination controls
  • Bulk marking operations with atomic timestamp updates
  • Performance-optimized queries using recipient-based filtering

  • Method Details

    • findByRecipientId

      public List<Notification> findByRecipientId(Long recipientId)
      Retrieves all notifications received by a specific user.

      This method finds all notifications where the specified user is the recipient. Notifications are typically ordered by creation time with most recent first. For better performance with large datasets, consider using the paginated version.

      Implementation uses JPQL query with ORDER BY clause to retrieve notifications sorted by timestamp in descending order (most recent first). This provides a natural ordering for notification display in user interfaces.

      Specified by:
      findByRecipientId in interface NotificationDAO
      Parameters:
      recipientId - The unique identifier of the recipient. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of notifications received by the specified user, or an empty list if no notifications are found
      See Also:
      • NotificationDAO.findByRecipientIdPaginated(Long, int, int)

    • findByRecipientIdPaginated

      public List<Notification> findByRecipientIdPaginated(Long recipientId, int offset, int limit)
      Retrieves notifications for a specific user with pagination and sorting.

      This method provides paginated access to notifications, which is essential for performance when users have large numbers of notifications. Results are typically sorted by creation time with most recent first.

      Implementation uses JPQL query with LIMIT and OFFSET clauses for efficient pagination. Results are ordered by timestamp in descending order to maintain consistent ordering across page boundaries.

      Specified by:
      findByRecipientIdPaginated in interface NotificationDAO
      Parameters:
      recipientId - The unique identifier of the recipient. Must not be null.
      offset - The number of results to skip (for pagination). Must be >= 0.
      limit - The maximum number of results to return. Must be > 0.
      Returns:
      A List of notifications received by the specified user, or an empty list if no notifications are found

    • countByRecipientId

      public Long countByRecipientId(Long recipientId)
      Counts the total number of notifications received by a specific user.

      This method provides the total count of notifications for a user, which is essential for implementing pagination controls and displaying total counts in user interfaces.

      Implementation uses COUNT function in JPQL for efficient counting without loading full notification entities. Essential for pagination controls and displaying total counts in user interfaces.

      Specified by:
      countByRecipientId in interface NotificationDAO
      Parameters:
      recipientId - The unique identifier of the recipient. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The total count of notifications for the user, or 0 if none exist

    • markAllNotificationsAsRead

      public Integer markAllNotificationsAsRead(Long recipientId)
      Marks all notifications as read for a specific user.

      This bulk operation updates the read status of all notifications for the specified user. Commonly used when users want to clear all unread notification indicators or during "mark all as read" operations.

      Implementation uses a bulk UPDATE query to atomically mark all unread notifications as read and set the read timestamp. This provides efficient "mark all as read" functionality for user interfaces.

      Specified by:
      markAllNotificationsAsRead in interface NotificationDAO
      Parameters:
      recipientId - The unique identifier of the user. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      The number of notifications that were marked as read
